* Fixed: Conflict resolution no longer loses local changes when two other devices make changes to other fields (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/574).
* Fixed: Deleted-and-reinserted records with the same record ID no longer fail (thanks @jsutula, https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/575).
* Added: Handle CloudKit rate limiting (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/569).
* Added: Cache unsynced records for faster migrations (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pul

* Fix: Add missing visionOS argument for when using UTF8Span to produce CollationOrder by @bobek-balinek in https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/562
* Infrastructure: Update CloudKit sync docs link by @DominikGrodl in https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/546
* @bobek-balinek made their first contribution in https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/562
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/compare/1.12.0...1.12.1

## What's Changed

* Added: User-defined collating sequences (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/532).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/compare/1.11.2...1.12.0

## What's Changed
* Fixed: StructuredQueries 0.38 support (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/540).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/compare/1.11.1...1.11.2

* Infrastructure: Bump to support IssueReporting 2.1 (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/491).
* Fixed: Resolve shared CloudKit database for shared records (thanks @baronfac, https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/409).
* Fixed: Nest temporary databases in a single directory for easier cleanup (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/537; https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/538)
* @baronfac made their first contribution in https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/

* Added: `ColumnCoding` passthrough trait to enable `ColumnCoding` in StructuredQueries (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/520).
* Fixed: Support strings with non-terminating `NUL` characters (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/525).
* Fixed: `@Fetch*` now wraps its state in SwiftUI's `@State` when possible, addressing potential SwiftUI glitches, including broken animation (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/504).
* Performance: Cache `@FetchAll` and `@FetchOne` state

## What's Changed

* Added: `@FetchOne` now automatically observes primary-keyed records (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/519).
* Added: `StrictDecoding`, a trait that throws an error when a decoded field's type doesn't match its SQL affinity (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/489).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/compare/1.9.0...1.10.0

MillionSend v0.28.1 fixes false alarms in the content monitor (#217) and in the matching of new teams against teams suspended for phishing (#216). Create inbox now lists every domain your team has (#215). No database migrations.

There is one database migration; see "Upgrading a self-hosted instance".
This release has a database migration, unlike v0.27.0.

MillionSend v0.27.0 stops the content monitor from suspending a New-tier team over a notice that a store or booking platform sends under a client business's name (#213). The notice waits in the review list instead, and once an operator releases one, later notices under that business's name go out without waiting. No database migrations.

MillionSend v0.26.1 is a maintenance release. Bcc recipients no longer travel inside the message handed to SES (#210), and the mail stack, Sentry and the AWS SDK move to their latest patch releases (#212). No database migrations.

MillionSend v0.26.0 changes three things. Teams on Scale can add 100 sending domains an hour, up from 10 (#211). Every rate limit and quota refusal now says when to try again (#211). Header values and subjects with quotes now go out as written, so `OTP-Token` headers can be sent (#209). No database migrations.

MillionSend v0.25.0 changes how the regional breaker works: it trips at SES's 0.1% review line and holds only the teams drawing the complaints (#207). On Cloud, several small Free accounts can no longer add up against the shared sending reputation (#205, #206). The content monitor makes fewer false holds (#204), and a few layouts are fixed (#208). There are three database migrations; see "Upgrading a self-hosted instance".
- **Three database migrations run on start:**
- **Feedback on unknown mail (#207).**

MillionSend v0.24.0 shows operators which teams are behind the console's hard-bounce and complaint numbers, and keeps every list row on one line (#197). Bounces and complaints that SES reports for mail it never attempted no longer count against a team, which matches SES's own rates. Several phone layouts are fixed. There are no database migrations and no new settings.
